description: Fixed, brand-neutral measurement prompt set for the offline answer-engine sweep. Deliberately generic: no project or customer brand, no domain, no email address, no URL and no credential may ever appear here (invariant 6). The set is fixed so cost/latency comparisons across routes and output treatments are apples-to-apples.

prompts.text: What should a small team look for when choosing project management software?
How do noise cancelling headphones actually reduce background sound?
Compare electric kettles with stovetop kettles for daily home use.
What are the trade offs between a standing desk and a regular desk?
Which features matter most when buying a first road bicycle on a budget?
What size air fryer suits a household of four people?
How often should a home heat pump be serviced and why?
What does a typical bicycle tune up include?
How can someone tell whether a local repair shop is trustworthy?
What questions should a renter ask before signing a lease?
Explain how a dishwasher uses less water than washing by hand.
Compare cold brew and drip coffee on taste, cost and preparation time.
